name: Jiangxi Welgao Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Welgao Electronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards in China and internationally. The company offers double-sided and multi-layer boards, including thick copper, mini LED optoelectronic, and planar transformer boards. Its products are used in power supplies, industrial control, new energy, digital communications, optical modules, automotive electronics, and displays applications. The company was formerly known as Huizhou Jiawei Investment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangxi Welgao Electronics Co., Ltd. in November 2021.
